stage: pre-registered action sensitivity + publicly observable model forecasting, not policy promotion

method_precedents.paper: Reijnen et al., Job shop scheduling benchmark: environments and instances for learning and non-learning methods
method_precedents.transferred: controlled simultaneous load / known scheduled job releases and baseline dispatching comparison
method_precedents.not_transferred: their FJSP simulator, actual benchmark instances, or pretrained policies

method_precedents.paper: Flores-Gómez and Dauzère-Pérès, Makespan service level for the flexible job-shop scheduling problem under machine-related uncertainty
method_precedents.transferred: deadline service level and processing-time uncertainty as evaluation dimensions
method_precedents.not_transferred: their scenario probability model or tabu-search solver

method_precedents.paper: Fan et al., Flexible job shop scheduling with stochastic machine breakdowns by an improved tuna swarm optimization algorithm
method_precedents.transferred: future equipment breakdowns motivate separate subsequent study
method_precedents.not_transferred: no breakdown injected this stage; no claimed failure forecasting

seed_precommit: 12 new scenario seeds; previous PR21-27 test groups not reused; grouping by scene seed
static_fixture: existing 7x5, 5 stations, workflow w0/w1, resource A capacity 1
exogenous_model: current simulator keyed service jitter; no new device outage, AGV faults, unknown arrivals, or posthoc random dynamics
release_observability: scheduled release times may be visible in scenario metadata: NOT a hidden/unknown online arrival benchmark

bounded_counterfactual.continuation: same original BusinessCPSAT first proposal online every subsequent tick
bounded_counterfactual.outcome_primary: final completion tick (smaller better), with lateness and waiting reported independently
bounded_counterfactual.censoring: if 240-tick horizon reached before all complete, report censored and do not rank these by unobserved finishing times
bounded_counterfactual.action_identifiable: difference in factual outcomes under one initial legal decision and identical continuation code; not random-trial causal identification

prediction_audit.prediction_continuation: same CP-SAT first-proposal policy on each particle's own predicted public state (not oracle future action)
prediction_audit.compare: forecast expected completed stages by H5/H10/H20 and realized H5/H10/H20 under corresponding treatment, plus paired horizon errors
prediction_audit.caveat: predicted stage completion rank may not correspond to final makespan; do not claim proof of decision value from forecast accuracy alone

stopping_rules: do not modify releases/deadlines/jobs/seeds or model score after observing results
if no pair has distinct outcome, close information-value gate as no measured opportunity
if outcomes differ, test whether model prospectively distinguishes their ordering; no model retraining in this PR
no new random fault process is justified by this experiment
